name: Grounded answers
what: Every shown statement cites a passage with a quote, or a cell or figure, checked by code

name: Stated abstention
what: When the sources cannot answer, says so and what was missing

name: Bring your own ontology
what: A provided Turtle master published and activated by configuration

name: Ontology discovery with review
what: A first draft from a sample, reviewed, with its evidence

name: Classified versions
what: Immutable versions; the bump says what changed; delta extraction after an additive one

name: Candidates and proposals
what: Terms extraction could not place, proposed as the next minor version

name: Structured lookup
what: Mapped tables beside the documents; cells and figures cited and recomputed

name: Passage search by meaning
what: A vector per passage; the hit is a passage id

name: Graph tools
what: Entities, neighbourhoods and paths in the ontology's terms, read only

name: The workbench
what: Steps as they happen, cost, term usage, what it would take, ontology requests

name: The ontology page
what: The active ontology as a graph with counts, tiers and a question overlay

name: Scope
what: Public and private sources, enforced at every hop

name: Sign-in through a host website
what: A framed page and a short grant in place of the deployment's own sign-in

name: Valves and quotas
what: Per-question limits, daily counts, concurrency, throttle

name: Budget alert
what: A monthly budget mailed at 80 percent

name: Evaluation sets
what: Questions with expected facts, scored deterministically

name: One-stack deployment
what: One module, images built in the account, two applies

name: Launch stack
what: CloudFormation running the same Terraform

name: Branding
what: Name, mark, colours, stylesheet, domain

name: Optional backends
what: Neo4j or Apache AGE as the graph projection, MongoDB as the document projection and chat state

name: Local run
what: A folder as the lake, the Anthropic API, the local portal server

name: Source adapters
what: S3 uploads, local folders, HTTPS URLs, and your own through an entry point

name: Idle at nothing
what: Pay-per-use services; the graph instance the one fixed cost, switchable

name: Document and table links
what: A signed link to the original or the bound snapshot, after the scope check
